examples.label: Example 1
examples.display:
shifts = [[0, 5], [3, 9], [8, 12], [4, 6]]
m      = 2
dayEnd = 12
output = [[0, 3], [6, 8], [9, 12]]

Only one driver works before 3, from 6 to 8 and from 9 on.

examples.label: Example 2
examples.display:
shifts = [[2, 4], [4, 7]]

dayEnd = 10

The two shifts touch at 4, so there is no gap there.
